data.name: Shibam
data.gender_notes: Shibam is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Shibam is derived from the Sanskrit word Shiva, which means 'God of Prosperity'. It is also associated with the concept of Shakti, the divine feminine power. In Hindu mythology, Shiva is considered to be the supreme god, the destroyer of evil, and the giver of boons. The name Shibam carries the meaning “God of Prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Bengali, Assamese. Parents who choose Shibam usually hope their child will grow to embody god of prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Shibam signifies the presence of the divine in one's life. It represents the power to overcome obstacles and achieve victory through determination and devotion.
data.etymology: Shibam belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Shibam total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
